answer: Submission uses a commit-reveal split. An identity first posts a hash commitment of its full answer, then must reveal the exact text in a later window; the ledger grades only text whose hash matches. A farm that waits to read a good cedar-threaded answer and copies it cannot forge the prior commitment, so its onyx bond is slashed on failed reveal. Honest work must precede observation; only the lotus of a pre-committed answer survives the window.
